```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
## ==========================================================
## TFCE fully crossed subject-item analysis in R
##
## Input:
##   ../data/08_designTable.csv
##   ../data/08_EEGdata_long.csv
##
## Model used for marginalization:
##   Amplitude ~ ConditionCode +
##     (1 | Subject) +
##     (1 | Item)
##
## Marginalization:
##   Subject- and item-specific random effects are removed.
##
## Local model after marginalization:
##   MarginalAmplitude ~ ConditionCode
##
## Test:
##   Treatment - Control fixed effect
##
## Condition coding:
##   Control   = -1
##   Treatment =  1
##
## Permutation:
##   Condition labels are shuffled unrestricted after marginalization
##
## EEG amplitudes are never permuted.
## Only condition labels are permuted.
## ==========================================================

rm(list = ls())

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

source("../R/tfce_transform.R")

cat("\nStarting fully crossed subject-item TFCE analysis...\n")

## ==========================================================
## -1. Load EEG long-format data
## ==========================================================

designTable <- read.csv("../data/08_designTable.csv")

EEGlong <- read.csv("../data/08_EEGdata_long.csv")

print(names(designTable))
print(names(EEGlong))

## ==========================================================
## 0. Prepare data
## ==========================================================

designTable <- designTable %>%
  mutate(RowID = row_number())

dat <- EEGlong %>%
  left_join(designTable, by = c("Subject", "Item", "ConditionCode")) %>%
  mutate(
    Subject = factor(Subject),
    Item = factor(Item),
    Channel = factor(Channel),
    ConditionCode = as.numeric(ConditionCode),
    Time = as.numeric(Time),
    Amplitude = as.numeric(Amplitude)
  )

channels <- unique(dat$Channel)
times <- sort(unique(dat$Time))

nChan <- length(channels)
nTime <- length(times)

cat("Number of observations in designTable:",
    nrow(designTable),
    "\n")

cat("Number of channels:", nChan, "\n")

cat("Number of time points:", nTime, "\n")

## ==========================================================
## Basic checks
## ==========================================================

if (any(is.na(dat$RowID))) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Some EEG rows could not be matched to designTable. ",
      "Check Subject, Item, and ConditionCode."
    )
  )
}

subject_item_units <- designTable %>%
  distinct(Subject, Item)

for (u in seq_len(nrow(subject_item_units))) {
  current_subject <- subject_item_units$Subject[u]
  current_item <- subject_item_units$Item[u]
  
  tmp <- designTable %>%
    filter(Subject == current_subject, Item == current_item)
  
  if (nrow(tmp) != 2) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Each Subject-Item combination must have exactly ",
        "two rows. Problematic combination: Subject ",
        current_subject,
        ", Item ",
        current_item
      )
    )
  }
  
  if (!all(sort(tmp$ConditionCode) == c(-1, 1))) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Each Subject-Item combination must contain one ",
        "Control observation (-1) and one Treatment ",
        "observation (1). Problematic combination: Subject ",
        current_subject,
        ", Item ",
        current_item
      )
    )
  }
}

cat("Basic design checks completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 0: Remove subject and item random effects
##
## For each channel-time point, fit:
##
##   Amplitude ~ ConditionCode +
##     (1 | Subject) +
##     (1 | Item)
##
## The marginalized response is:
##
##   fixed-effect fitted values + conditional residuals
##
## This removes the estimated subject- and item-specific
## random intercepts while preserving the condition effect
## and unexplained residual variation.
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 0: Removing subject and item random effects...\n")

marginal_dat <- dat %>%
  group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
  group_modify( ~ {
    fit <- lmer(Amplitude ~ ConditionCode +
                  (1 | Subject) +
                  (1 | Item), data = .x)
    
    fixed_fitted <- predict(fit, re.form = NA)
    
    conditional_residuals <- residuals(fit)
    
    .x %>%
      mutate(MarginalAmplitude =
               fixed_fitted +
               conditional_residuals)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Marginalization stage completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## -2. Function to compute the local t-map
##
## After marginalization, the local model is:
##
##   MarginalAmplitude ~ ConditionCode
## ==========================================================

compute_tmap <- function(data) {
  res <- data %>%
    group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
    group_modify( ~ {
      fit <- lm(MarginalAmplitude ~ ConditionCode, data = .x)
      
      cf <- coef(summary(fit))
      
      tibble(t_Cond = cf["ConditionCode", "t value"])
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  t_values <- res %>%
    mutate(
      Channel = factor(Channel, levels = channels),
      Time = factor(Time, levels = times)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Channel, Time) %>%
    pull(t_Cond)
  
  matrix(
    t_values,
    nrow = nChan,
    ncol = nTime,
    byrow = TRUE,
    dimnames = list(channels, times)
  )
}

## ==========================================================
## Step 1: Observed t-map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 1: Computing observed t-map...\n")

t_Obs <- compute_tmap(marginal_dat)

cat("Observed t-map completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 2: Observed TFCE map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 2: Computing observed TFCE map...\n")

TFCE_Obs <- tfce_transform(t_Obs, E = 0.66, H = 2, dh = 0.1)

cat("Observed TFCE map completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 3: Permutation distribution
## ==========================================================

set.seed(123)

nPerm <- 999

TFCE_permMax <- rep(NaN, nPerm)

cat("Step 3: Starting permutation test:", nPerm, "permutations...\n")

design_info <- designTable %>%
  select(RowID, ConditionCode)

for (p in seq_len(nPerm)) {
  perm_info <- design_info %>%
    mutate(ConditionCode = sample(ConditionCode))
  
  perm_marginal_dat <- marginal_dat %>%
    select(-ConditionCode) %>%
    left_join(perm_info, by = "RowID")
  
  ## ===========================================================
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## 3.1 Compute permutation t-map
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  t_perm <- compute_tmap(perm_marginal_dat)
  
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## 3.4 Compute permutation TFCE map
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  TFCE_perm <- tfce_transform(t_perm, E = 0.66, H = 2, dh = 0.1)
  
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## 3.5 Store maximum absolute TFCE statistic
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  TFCE_permMax[p] <- max(abs(TFCE_perm), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (p %% 50 == 0) {
    cat("Permutation", p, "of", nPerm, "\n")
  }
}

cat("Permutation testing completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 4: TFCE-corrected significance
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 4: Computing TFCE-corrected significance...\n")

alpha <- 0.05

## ==========================================================
## Include the observed assignment in the maximum-TFCE
## distribution
## ==========================================================

maxTFCE <- sort(c(TFCE_permMax, max(abs(TFCE_Obs), na.rm = TRUE)))

critical_index <- round((nPerm + 1) * (1 - alpha))

maxTFCEcrit <- maxTFCE[critical_index]

Mask <- abs(TFCE_Obs) >= maxTFCEcrit

## ==========================================================
## Compute family-wise-error-corrected p-values
## ==========================================================

P_Values <- matrix(NA,
                   nrow = nChan,
                   ncol = nTime,
                   dimnames = dimnames(TFCE_Obs))

for (ch in seq_len(nChan)) {
  for (t in seq_len(nTime)) {
    P_Values[ch, t] <-
      (sum(TFCE_permMax >= abs(TFCE_Obs[ch, t]), na.rm = TRUE) + 1) /
      (nPerm + 1)
  }
}

cat("TFCE-corrected significance completed.\n")

cat(sprintf("Critical TFCE value = %.4f\n", maxTFCEcrit))

## ==========================================================
## Step 5: Store results
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 5: Storing results...\n")

Results <- list(
  tObs         = t_Obs,
  TFCE_Obs     = TFCE_Obs,
  TFCE_Null    = TFCE_permMax,
  maxTFCEcrit  = maxTFCEcrit,
  P_Values     = P_Values,
  Mask         = Mask,
  alpha        = alpha,
  nPerm        = nPerm,
  mixed_model = paste0("Amplitude ~ ConditionCode + ", "(1 | Subject) + ", "(1 | Item)"),
  
  local_model = paste0("MarginalAmplitude ~ ConditionCode"),
  
  test = paste0("Treatment - Control fixed effect"),
  
  marginalization = paste0("Subject- and item-specific random effects removed"),
  
  permutation = paste0("Condition-label flipping within each Subject-Item pair")
  
)

cat("Results stored.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 6: Save TFCE results
## ==========================================================

if (!dir.exists("../Results")) {
  dir.create("../Results")
}


save(
  Results,
  times,
  nChan,
  channels,
  
  file = paste0("../Results/",
                "08_TFCE_fully_crossed_subject_item_results.RData")
)

cat(paste0(
  "Fully crossed subject-item TFCE analysis ",
  "completed and results saved.\n"
))
```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
rm(list = ls())
load("../Results/08_TFCE_fully_crossed_subject_item_results.RData")
source("../R/plot_eeg_map.R")
## ==========================================================
## Step 7: Plot significant effects
## ==========================================================

mT <- Results$tObs
mT[!Results$Mask] <- 0

plot_eeg_map(mT, "TFCE-corrected Group Effect", times, nChan, channels)

## ==========================================================
## Step 7: Plot observed TFCE values
## ==========================================================

plot_eeg_map(Results$TFCE_Obs,
             "Observed TFCE Map: Group Effect Adjusted for Covariate",
             times,
             nChan, channels)
```
